llm.summary: This skill transparently sets up a scoped memory/context pipeline and does not show hidden exfiltration, destructive behavior, or deception.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a deterministic agent memory pipeline: route messages, retrieve from a file-based memory layout, compress context, lint, validate, and run fixtures.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation and router terms are somewhat broad, so the pipeline may be applied or route prompts more often than expected, but the behavior is disclosed and tied to the stated memory/context purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation copies bundled files into context_pipeline and instructs the agent to patch AGENTS.md, show diffs, validate, and report git status; these are workspace mutations but are explicit and user-directed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads scoped memory files such as memory/always_on.md, memory/topics, now/open-loops, automation, MEMORY.md, and sometimes recent daily logs; this is proportionate for a memory pipeline but may involve private user context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It can persist AGENTS.md instructions, memory notes, and debug/audit runtime artifacts, but there is no evidence of background workers, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, external network exfiltration, or destructive commands.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only in workspaces where you want a file-based memory pipeline. Review the AGENTS.md diff before accepting it, use explicit commands like apply or memorize, and remember that debug/audit modes can write retrieved context artifacts to disk.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: File reads/writes and command execution are real, but they are disclosed as installation, validation, AGENTS.md patching, and memory-pipeline setup rather than hidden capability.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad activation phrases and keyword routing could cause over-application or misrouting, but this is a usability/scope caveat within the advertised default memory pipeline rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent writes to context_pipeline, AGENTS.md, memory files, and debug/audit artifacts are part of the documented workflow; users should still review diffs and avoid storing sensitive details unintentionally.
